notes: A cleaner look with 4 tabs and the coach button at the top right. Focus mode shows one exercise at a time with big buttons and a rest countdown. After each lift, tap how hard it was, and your tracker suggests your next weights (tap the set number to log them). A finish summary, a weekly countdown and week streak, 4-week training blocks, sets by muscle, a 30, 45 or full-length workout option, milestone badges, a My Plan card, and Snap a label or Snap a meal on Food.
knowledgeNotes: New training knowledge: a plan-building playbook (weekly sets by goal, effort, progression, deload ranges), a recommendation guide (fixes and options for common feedback), and an exercise A to Z of extra exercises for each muscle group. Your coach uses it quietly when you ask for a change. Say "turn on plan review" if you want it to suggest plan updates.
